# Workshop state machines

**Generated by `server/workshop/render-states.mjs` — do not edit by hand.**
Change `server/workshop/state-machines.js` and re-run it.

These are independent on purpose: approval, custody, work and collection are
separate facts. A bike can be finished but uncollected, or approved and not
started. Cross-machine rules are enforced in
`tests/workshop-state-invariants.test.js`.

**Rest** means nothing happens from here on its own. Some rest states have no
way out at all; others are left only by a deliberate act, such as reopening a
job or bringing a bike back.

## bookingRequest

Starts at `pending`. Rests at `declined`, `expired`, `cancelled`.

| From | Event | To |
|---|---|---|
| `pending` | `accept` | `scheduled` |
| `pending` | `decline` | `declined` |
| `pending` | `expire` | `expired` |
| `pending` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
| `scheduled` | `request_reschedule` | `reschedule_requested` |
| `scheduled` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |
| `reschedule_requested` | `accept` | `scheduled` |
| `reschedule_requested` | `decline` | `scheduled` |
| `reschedule_requested` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |

## custody

Starts at `expected`. Rests at `collected`.

| From | Event | To |
|---|---|---|
| `expected` | `book_in` | `in_shop` |
| `in_shop` | `collect` | `collected` |
| `collected` | `reopen` | `in_shop` |

## work

Starts at `not_started`. Rests at `complete`.

| From | Event | To |
|---|---|---|
| `not_started` | `start` | `in_progress` |
| `not_started` | `hold` | `on_hold` |
| `in_progress` | `await_parts` | `waiting_parts` |
| `in_progress` | `hold` | `on_hold` |
| `in_progress` | `finish` | `complete` |
| `waiting_parts` | `parts_arrived` | `in_progress` |
| `waiting_parts` | `hold` | `on_hold` |
| `on_hold` | `resume` | `in_progress` |
| `complete` | `reopen` | `in_progress` |
